onboarding.splashTagline: Your personal stylist — matched to your color type, body shape, and measurements, not just your wardrobe.

howItWorks.title: More than a wardrobe app
howItWorks.subtitle: Every recommendation is built around you, not a trend.
howItWorks.feature1Text: Picked a red top that clashes with your coloring? We'll tell you before you wear it.
howItWorks.feature2Text: Love oversized, but your shape calls for slim? We'll say so — and what to wear instead.
howItWorks.feature3Text: Not just a scanner — Shoom analyzes you and gives real advice to help you look your best.

stepSubtitles.bodyType: The AI Stylist uses this to recommend cuts that actually flatter you.
stepSubtitles.colorDna: This is how the AI Stylist knows which colors work best on you.

bodyTypeDescriptions.Hourglass: Balanced shoulders and hips with a defined waist.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Trapezoid: Broad shoulders tapering gently to a narrower waist.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Inverted Triangle: Broader shoulders and chest than hips.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Rectangle: Shoulders, waist, and hips are similarly proportioned.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Oval: Fuller through the midsection, narrower shoulders and hips.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Triangle: Hips broader than shoulders, weight carried lower.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Pear (Triangle): Hips and thighs fuller than the shoulders and bust.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Apple (Round): Fuller midsection with slimmer arms and legs.
bodyTypeDescriptions.Diamond: Waist fuller than both shoulders and hips.
